desc:
Welcome to Would You Rather: Outfit Contest Tower! 💖

Choose a door and build your outfit step by step ✨
Every choice gives you a new item for your look:
💇 Hair
👗 Clothes
👟 Shoes
🎀 Accessories
😊 Faces
💅 Cute style details

Start as a blank avatar and climb the tower while creating your final fit 🗼💖

Reach the top, save your outfit, and show off your best look!
Join outfit contests, vote for other players, and see who makes it to the TOP 3 podium 👑

Can you build the cutest outfit and win the style contest? 💅✨

🛒 Some avatar items can be purchased and added to your Roblox inventory!
💗 Like the game + join the group for extra rewards!
✨ More updates coming soon!
